JobRadar finds jobs in Portugal on many sites at once, for any job title and any level (internship, junior, mid-level, senior or lead), and scores each one against your profile.

**New in this version**
- **Bliss, the assistant**: the round button in the corner opens a chat beside your jobs (the whole screen on a phone). Ask about your search or the app ("why do I have so few new jobs?", "which jobs should I look at first?"), or say what you're after ("I want a software engineer job in Braga"): Bliss shows the jobs you already have that fit and proposes changing your search, then searching again.
- **Nothing changes until you press Confirm**: Bliss can propose a job's status, a change to your search, searching now or an application message, and shows exactly what will change first.
- **🔊 Bliss can read its answers aloud**, with Gemini's voice. It works in Portuguese and English, and each job's Description has **Ask Bliss about this job**.
- **Your data stays yours**: Bliss answers from a summary of your jobs, profile and sources, never your notes or contact details, and the conversation stays on your device. It needs your free Gemini key (or the Claude key to write, plus the Gemini key for the voice).
- **Two more sources**: Sapo Emprego, one of Portugal's largest job boards, and Breezy HR careers sites (Critical Software). The same job on Sapo and on another site shows as one card.
- **Clearer errors**: a site that asks for a browser check (bot protection) now says so, instead of an HTTP 403 or 429.

**Android**: download `JobRadar-…-android.apk` below and open it.

**Windows**: download `JobRadar-…-windows-setup.exe` below and run it. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway**.

**macOS / Linux**: run this in a terminal:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FuzzyLaDuzzy/jobradar/main/install.sh | sh
```

New versions install over the old one and keep your data.
